blocks.text: Indexing se sequence ka ek ek item nikala jata hai. Python zero-based indexing istemal karti hai: pehle item ka index 0, doosre ka 1, aur isi tarah aage.

blocks.prompt: "Python Programming" mein index 2 par kaunsa letter hai?

blocks.text: index badal kar Run karein aur dekhein string ke kis position (jagah) par kaunsa letter hai. Pehla letter index 0 par hota hai.

text = "Python Programming"
index = 0
print("Index", index, "par letter:", text[index])
print("Aakhri index:", len(text) - 1)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"text = "Python Programming"": ek string jis mein 18 characters hain (beech wala space bhi ginti mein aata hai).
"index = 0": is variable mein woh position (jagah) hai jis ka letter chahiye.
"print("Index", index, "par letter:", text[index])": text[0] pehla letter "P" deta hai.
"print("Aakhri index:", len(text) - 1)": len(text) 18 hai; index 0 se shuru hota hai, is liye aakhri index 18 - 1 = 17.
Output: "Index 0 par letter: P" aur "Aakhri index: 17".
Khud try karein: index = 7 kar ke Run karein: "Programming" wala "P" aayega (index 6 par space hai).
